sk.title: CSS View Transitions
sk.subtitle: Od základov v CSS až po element-scoped transitions
sk.description: View Transitions API prináša natívne animácie prechodov medzi stavmi stránky. Od CSS-only MPA prechodov po JavaScript riadené SPA animácie a nové element-scoped transitions v Chrome 147+.
sk.author: Lukáš Chylík

sk.title: Figma Beyond Design
sk.subtitle: Figma API, Variable Code Syntax, Code Connect a MCP server ako nástroje na automatizáciu design-to-code workflow.
sk.description: Ako využiť Figma API, Variable Code Syntax, Code Connect a MCP server na automatizáciu design tokenov a generovanie production-ready komponent.
sk.author: Lukáš Chylík

sk.title: CSS Cascade Layers, @scope a moderné selektory
sk.subtitle: Ako vrstvy, scope a nové pseudo-classy menia pravidlá kaskády
sk.description: Specificita bola vždy základným kameňom CSS. Dnes k nej pribúdajú cascade layers, @scope a moderné selektory ako :has() či :where(), ktoré zásadne menia spôsob, akým skladáme štýly.
sk.author: Lukáš Chylík

sk.title: CSS Carousel
sk.subtitle: Nové CSS pseudo-classy :scroll-button, :scroll-marker a :scroll-marker-group
sk.description: Scroll Spy navigácia či tabs komponenta bez JavaScriptu a prístupne? Zabudnite na komplexné JavaScript knižnice! CSS carousel je gamechanger.
sk.author: Lukáš Chylík

sk.title: Farby na webe v roku 2025
sk.subtitle: OKLCH, relative colors a CSS color-mix()
sk.description: Web design prešiel v roku 2025 revolúciou vo farbách. Zatiaľ čo tradičné RGB a HSL formáty stále dominujú, nové CSS funkcie ako OKLCH, relative colors a color-mix() prinášajú web developerom bezprecedentné možnosti práce s farbami.
sk.author: Lukáš Chylík

sk.title: CSS container scroll-state queries
sk.subtitle: Nový spôsob ako reagovať na stav scrollovania v CSS
sk.description: Objavte, ako môžete pomocou CSS container scroll-state queries vytvárať interaktívne prvky reagujúce na scrollovanie bez použitia JavaScriptu.
sk.author: Lukáš Chylík

sk.title: CSS scroll-driven animácie
sk.subtitle: Revolúcia webových animácií bez JavaScriptu
sk.description: Zabudnite na knižnice ako ScrollReveal, AOS alebo Scroll Magic! Moderné CSS ich hravo strčí do vrecka.
sk.author: Lukáš Chylík

en.title: CSS View Transitions
en.subtitle: From CSS fundamentals to element-scoped transitions
en.description: The View Transitions API brings native animated transitions between page states. From CSS-only MPA transitions to JavaScript-driven SPA animations and the new element-scoped transitions in Chrome 147+.
en.author: Lukáš Chylík

en.title: Figma Beyond Design
en.subtitle: Figma API, Variable Code Syntax, Code Connect and MCP server as tools for automating the design-to-code workflow.
en.description: How to use the Figma API, Variable Code Syntax, Code Connect and MCP server to automate design tokens and generate production-ready components.
en.author: Lukáš Chylík

en.title: CSS Cascade Layers, @scope and Modern Selectors
en.subtitle: How layers, scope and new pseudo-classes are changing the rules of the cascade
en.description: Specificity has always been a cornerstone of CSS. Today it is joined by cascade layers, @scope and modern selectors like :has() and :where(), which fundamentally change the way we compose styles.
en.author: Lukáš Chylík

en.title: CSS Carousel
en.subtitle: New CSS pseudo-classes :scroll-button, :scroll-marker and :scroll-marker-group
en.description: Scroll Spy navigation or a tabs component without JavaScript, and accessible? Forget complex JavaScript libraries! The CSS carousel is a gamechanger.
en.author: Lukáš Chylík

en.title: Colors on the Web in 2025
en.subtitle: OKLCH, relative colors and CSS color-mix()
en.description: Web design went through a color revolution in 2025. While traditional RGB and HSL formats still dominate, new CSS features like OKLCH, relative colors and color-mix() give web developers unprecedented ways to work with color.
en.author: Lukáš Chylík

en.title: CSS container scroll-state queries
en.subtitle: A new way to react to scroll state in CSS
en.description: Discover how CSS container scroll-state queries let you build interactive elements that respond to scrolling without using JavaScript.
en.author: Lukáš Chylík

en.title: CSS scroll-driven animations
en.subtitle: A revolution in web animations without JavaScript
en.description: Forget libraries like ScrollReveal, AOS or Scroll Magic! Modern CSS puts them all to shame with ease.
en.author: Lukáš Chylík
